method: Read every official Codeforces problem Input section; constraints below are factual paraphrases, not copies of problem statements. Domain generators retain correlations.

194-A.title: Exams
194-A.constraints: Exam count n in [1,50]; integer sum k in [1,250]; a feasible sum of n grades from 2 through 5. Thus 2*n <= k <= 5*n.

476-A.title: Dreamoon and Stairs
476-A.constraints: Integer n in [1,10000]; integer m in [2,10].

638-A.title: Home Numbers
638-A.constraints: Integers n,a satisfy 1 <= a <= n <= 100000; n is even.

90-A.title: Cableway
90-A.constraints: Integers r,g,b in [0,100]; their sum is positive.

112-B.title: Petya and Square
112-B.constraints: First integer is the even side length (called 2n in the statement), from 2 to 100; both coordinates range from 1 to that side length.

168-A.title: Wizards and Demonstration
168-A.constraints: Integers n,x,y are each from 1 to 10000; x <= n. The percentage y can exceed 100 because added clones count as demonstrators while the original population n remains fixed.

197-A.title: Plate Game
197-A.constraints: Integers a,b,r are each from 1 to 100.

216-A.title: Tiling with Hexagons
216-A.constraints: Integers a,b,c are each from 2 to 1000.

515-A.title: Drazil and Date
515-A.constraints: Coordinates a,b each range from -1000000000 to 1000000000; integer step count s ranges from 1 to 2000000000.

546-A.title: Soldier and Bananas
546-A.constraints: Integers k,w in [1,1000]; initial funds n in [0,1000000000].

659-A.title: Round House
659-A.constraints: Integers n,a satisfy 1 <= a <= n <= 100; displacement b ranges from -100 to 100.

675-A.title: Infinite Sequence
675-A.constraints: Integers a,b,c each range from -1000000000 to 1000000000; zero step c is allowed.
